boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten named UML study environments, spanning library quiet zones, reservable rooms, and academic-building work areas on North and South Campuses.

cards.title: O’Leary Library First Floor
cards.subtitle: South Campus — Learning Commons and study rooms
cards.notes: Set up at a table in the Learning Commons, or scan the QR code outside a study room to reserve space for a group session.
cards.short_summary: A service-rich library floor with tables, public computers and remaining study rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: UMass Lowell lists Centers for Learning tables, public computers and study rooms on O’Leary’s first floor; group rooms are reservable by QR code.
cards.access_notes: University Library’s posted Spring 2026 hours list Monday–Thursday 7:30 a.m.–11 p.m.; reserve a group room using its door QR code.

cards.title: O’Leary Library Third Floor
cards.subtitle: South Campus — open rooms, furniture and printing
cards.notes: Use an open study room for a focused block, then keep printing or computer tasks on the same floor instead of relocating mid-session.
cards.short_summary: A flexible O’Leary floor with open rooms, comfortable furniture, computers and printers.
cards.evidence_claim: UMass Lowell reports open study rooms, comfortable furniture, public computers and black-and-white printers on O’Leary Library’s third floor.
cards.access_notes: University Library’s posted Spring 2026 hours list Monday–Thursday 7:30 a.m.–11 p.m.

cards.title: O’Leary Library Fourth Floor
cards.subtitle: South Campus — library services and quiet-study context
cards.notes: Bring research questions with you: library service desks are on this floor, while a designated quiet-study area is listed nearby in O’Leary.
cards.short_summary: A library-services floor suited to combining independent work with walk-up research help.
cards.evidence_claim: UMass Lowell states that O’Leary’s library services are on the fourth floor and identifies a fourth-floor quiet study area with computers and printers.
cards.access_notes: University Library’s posted Spring 2026 hours list Monday–Thursday 7:30 a.m.–11 p.m.; research help is offered at O’Leary Monday–Wednesday afternoons.

cards.entity_name: Lydon Library First and Second Floors
cards.title: Lydon Library First and Second Floors
cards.subtitle: North Campus — group-study areas and bookable space
cards.notes: Meet collaborators on the first or second floor, and use the second-floor booking option when your project needs a dedicated group room.
cards.short_summary: The collaborative side of Lydon, with group areas and second-floor bookable study space.
cards.evidence_claim: UMass Lowell identifies group study areas on Lydon’s first and second floors, with group study spaces available to book on the second floor.
cards.access_notes: University Library’s posted Spring 2026 hours list Monday–Thursday 7:30 a.m.–11 p.m.; group rooms are reserved via QR codes outside rooms.

cards.title: Lydon Library Third Floor
cards.subtitle: North Campus — quiet study and window-side desks
cards.notes: Choose a window-side desk when working solo, and use the floor’s quiet-study setting for reading, drafting or concentrated problem sets.
cards.short_summary: A quiet Lydon floor with window-side desks.
cards.evidence_claim: UMass Lowell lists Lydon Library’s third floor as a quiet study area with window-side desks and scenic views.
cards.access_notes: University Library’s posted Spring 2026 hours list Monday–Thursday 7:30 a.m.–11 p.m.

cards.title: Lydon Library Fourth Floor
cards.subtitle: North Campus — quiet study and window-side desks
cards.notes: Use this upper-floor quiet area for an individual work block; select a window-side desk when you want natural light and an outward view.
cards.short_summary: Another quiet Lydon option, separate from its group-oriented lower floors.
cards.evidence_claim: UMass Lowell lists Lydon Library’s fourth floor as a quiet study area with window-side desks and scenic views.
cards.access_notes: University Library’s posted Spring 2026 hours list Monday–Thursday 7:30 a.m.–11 p.m.

cards.title: Coburn Hall
cards.subtitle: South Campus — floor-by-floor study areas and rooms
cards.notes: Start with the study space on your floor, or use first- and second-floor study rooms; the basement also has workspaces for a change of setting.
cards.short_summary: An academic-building option with study areas on every floor, rooms and basement workspaces.
cards.evidence_claim: UMass Lowell lists study spaces on each Coburn Hall floor, study rooms on the first and second floors, and basement workspaces.
cards.access_notes: The source identifies multiple study locations in Coburn Hall but does not state building access hours or room-reservation rules.

cards.title: Weed Hall
cards.subtitle: South Campus — first-floor desks and upper-floor cubicles
cards.notes: Choose a first-floor desk for a quick session, or take a cubicle on the second or third floor when you need a more individually defined workspace.
cards.short_summary: A straightforward South Campus choice with desks below and cubicles above.
cards.evidence_claim: UMass Lowell lists desks on Weed Hall’s first floor and cubicles on its second and third floors.
cards.access_notes: The source identifies study furniture by floor but does not state building access hours or reservation requirements.

cards.title: Health and Social Sciences Building
cards.subtitle: South Campus — second- and third-floor tables
cards.notes: Use the second- or third-floor tables between classes, especially if your work connects to nursing, physical therapy, kinesiology or economics coursework.
cards.short_summary: Table-based study areas inside UML’s Health and Social Sciences Building.
cards.evidence_claim: UMass Lowell lists tables and chairs on the building’s second and third floors, including dedicated areas for several health and academic departments.
cards.access_notes: The source identifies second- and third-floor seating but does not state building access hours or reservation requirements.

cards.entity_name: Pulichino Tong Business Center Top Floor
cards.title: Pulichino Tong Business Center Top Floor
cards.subtitle: North Campus — open seating with views
cards.notes: Head to the top floor when you want open seating and views; workspaces are also listed throughout the building if that floor is unavailable.
cards.short_summary: An upper-floor open-seating option in the Pulichino Tong Business Center.
cards.evidence_claim: UMass Lowell states that Pulichino Tong Business Center has workspaces on all floors and open seating with views on the top floor.
cards.access_notes: The source identifies workspaces and top-floor seating but does not state building access hours or reservation requirements.
